item.text: The safe rollout constraint is additive sequencing: deploy the new ledger everywhere first, then deploy customer. That lets the new ledger understand the idempotency key while still accepting old customer requests; it also keeps rollback safe because old customer requests remain supported. I’ll implement three total attempts with `ref-1`/`ref-2`/`ref-3`, preserving non-timeout errors.
